Mod.Name: 【便利】掌柜帮手·便利替换 | [QoL] Shopkeeper's Kit: Quick Swap
Mod.Author: ChaosN
Mod.Description:
【便利型：不改任何数值，只帮你省操作】换电池、换滤水器不用再打开机器：把新电池直接拖到机器上，就换下里面的旧电池，旧电池放回新电池原来的位置；把新滤水器拖到水罐上同理。悬停时显示绿色的使用提示。一键灌水：拖着瓶子按 W，指着水龙头装满、指着容器倒进去；空瓶指着容器就用自来水来回装瓶倒进去，直到灌满（要先解锁锈水或溢流水管道）。机器里有空槽时照原版直接放进去；电池拖到电池上互换等原版效果不受影响。可在改装件设置里分别关闭电池、滤水器。界面中英双语，跟随游戏语言。 掌柜帮手系列 · 作者 ChaosN · 由 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编程助手）协助开发。
[QoL - no balance changes] Swap batteries and filters without opening anything: drop a new battery on a machine and it replaces the battery inside, with the old one going where the new one was; drop a new filter on a water pitcher the same way. Hovering shows the green "use on" hint. One-key water filling: hold a bottle and press W - over the tap to fill it, over a container to pour; an empty bottle over a container keeps fetching tap water until it's full (needs the rust water or gutterflow pipe). Empty slots still work as in the base game, and base-game drops such as battery-on-battery swaps are unchanged. Batteries and filters can be turned off separately in the mod settings. UI in Chinese and English, following the game language. Part of Shopkeeper's Kit by ChaosN. Developed with assistance from Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant).
